thread:
jamie: Heads up — nightly perf CI flagged a p95 jump for small-batch around 03:12 UTC, ~+28% vs baseline. stack traces show scheduler stalls. cc @sasha @mohit
ci-bot: [alert] nightly-smallbatch | p95: 318ms (baseline 248ms) | commit: a9d3f2c | link: https://ci.internal/run/9876/artifacts :rotating_light:
li: grabbing the flame graph now, saving profile to /artifacts/4299991111/profile.pb.gz — will post link when ready :mag_right:
sasha: thanks. any obvious commit correlation? quick glance at changelog shows kernel scheduling tweak in runtime/scheduler from @alan two commits ago — could be related
mohit: is this repro on staging or only on main-nightly?
jamie: only on main-nightly. can reproduce locally with the nightly image and a small-batch replay script (sampled inputs).
li: profile uploaded: https://ci.internal/artifacts/4299991111/profile.pb.gz — flame graph attached. looks like a few hot syscalls and a weird mutex spin in batcher::flush().
jamie: repro steps I used: ```export IMAGE=redwood/nightly:2026-03-18 && ./scripts/replay_smallbatch.sh --image $IMAGE --iters 500 --concurrency 8``` got the same p95 jump.
sasha: can someone run a quick bisect across the last 6 commits (scheduler + batcher changes)? if we can narrow to one CL we can revert or patch a workaround for tonight.
mohit: I'll start a quick bisect job against the nightly harness. giving it 10-15m to spin up. will post results here.
ops-bot: NOTE: routing fallback switched to gpu-pool-b in the evening to absorb spikes — monitoring for spillover.
li: adding one-off profiler flags to the nightly job: `--sched-trace=1 --kv-sample=0.1` so we get more context next run.
jamie: if bisect isolates a scheduler change, can we also try toggling `SCHED_YIELD_COOP=1` env var as a quick mitigation? tried locally and it shaved ~6% p95.
sasha: good idea. also add `--sample-rate=5` on the next CI run to reduce noise in traces.
mohit: bisect status: testing commit range a9c..b12 now — first candidate failed, second candidate passed. looks like culprit is b05 (runtime/scheduler: adjust spin/backoff policy).
jamie: confirmed b05 locally — flip that flag out and p95 returns to baseline. opening a revert PR now: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pull/4321 :white_check_mark:
sasha: nice. can we land a short-term revert in the night pipeline and schedule a deeper fix for next week?
li: rolling a canary: pinned nightly to pre-b05 image and added fallback rule for 3 hours. alerting on health checks.
jamie: PR up and CI green on revert. requesting review from @sasha @mohit — will merge after one ack.
mohit: acked, merging now. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: [deploy] pinned image rollback applied to nightly-main at 03:48 UTC — watch p95 for next two cycles.
li: new run completed, p95 back to 250ms. keeping canary for one more run, then remove pin if stable. :eyes:
sasha: great triage everyone. add a short postmortem note in the incidents channel and a link to the bisect log and profile. I can take the follow-up to implement a safer backoff strategy next week.
jamie: filing a brief incident note and attaching artifacts. thanks all.
ops-bot: reminder: if anyone wants the raw perf data, it lives in s3://redwood-ci/nightly/4299991111/ — do not delete until postmortem closed.
